messages:
miko: heads up — bringing aether-lite-v2 (int8) into staging for multilingual smoke tests and seeing a consistent BLEU drop on zh-Hant translations (~-4.2) vs fp16 baseline. also some weird tokenization around ruby/furigana and ZWJ combos in outputs. cc @rahul :eyes:
rahul: ack. can you paste a tiny repro (input + output) and the eval command you ran?
miko: input: "《源氏》の注釈：〈るい〉は…" (ja with ruby), and another: zh-hant source with ruby-like annotations.
example cmd: `python eval.py --model aether-lite-v2 --quant int8 --locales zh_Hant,ja_JP,ar_EG --batch 32 --seed 123`
output snippet (detok): `《源氏》的注释：〈るい〉是…` — ruby markers turned into angle brackets in wrong places, and for zh-hant numbers sometimes merged with following han characters (no space).
rahul: can you also paste tokenizer ids? suspect token merge table changed in the int8 quant step (we've seen merge collisions in previous qconfigs).
miko: tokenizer.encode("《源氏》の注釈：〈るい〉は…") => [5021, 11234, 78, 9032, 11, 44, 9999] (approx). detok via model.detok() => weird bracket placement.
kai: quick checks — is this reproduced in fp16 or only int8?
miko: fp16 baseline looks fine. int8 only.
eval-bot: Eval run created: https://ci.redwood/runs/17890 — zh_Hant BLEU: 21.3 (fp16 25.5), ja_JP unchanged, ar_EG perplexity +12%.
rahul: this smells like token id collisions after quantized kernel remap. last kernel patch (fastmerge-v2) introduced a fallback that remaps some composite subtokens. I'll bisect.
sarah: I can run a focused detok/regression harness: compare tokenization (encode -> ids -> detok) across quant config. command I'll run: `./scripts/compare_tokenflows.sh --model aether-lite-v2 --configs fp16,int8-fastmerge,int8-legacy --samples 500 --locale zh_Hant`
eva: also check normalizer settings (NFKC vs NFC) and CLDR locale tagging — we had a case where locale tag stripping caused different segmentation.
kai: also try disabling prefix merging (`--no-prefix-merge`) in tokenizer, sometimes that affects ruby brackets.
rahul: starting bisect between commits ca1f5..d1b2e (kernel selection) now. will post midpoints.
miko: attaching a minimal failing example in-case it's needed: `src: "【注】〈るい〉應該..." -> int8 detok: "【注】<るい>應該..."` (brackets swapped).
sarah: ran compare_tokenflows locally (100 samples) — int8-fastmerge shows an extra subtoken split at U+3008/U+3009 (left/right angle brackets) which fp16 keeps as single token. diff example: fp16 ids: [...,4321,...] int8-fastmerge ids: [..., 432, 1, ...]
rahul: confirmed initial bisect point 1 -> commit d3f4a caused tokenizer merge-table rebuild with new hash seed. that correlates with model compile time change.
eva: could this be a remapping in the quantized tokenizer lookup table (we store a packed uint16->subtoken mapping)?
rahul: yes likely. next step: reproduce the mapping with a direct tokenizer tool: `python tools/inspect_merge.py --model aether-lite-v2 --commit d3f4a --out /tmp/mapping.json`
miko: assigned to rahul + sarah to produce a patch or fallback. tagging ops for a quick canary rollback if needed. :rotating_light:
rahul: plan: 1) reproduce and confirm mapping delta 2) attempt to regenerate quantized merge table with original seed 3) run full eval on staging (subset locales) 4) if no quick fix, roll back kernel change on staging and schedule patch.
eval-bot: quick smoke after staging rollback (if performed) will trigger nightly-eval.
sarah: ran quick local regen of merge table with original seed -> tokenizer parity restored for the sample set. pushing a candidate patch to aether-lite-v2-int8 branch: `pr/2123`
rahul: thanks. i'll run the full eval (5000 samples) tomorrow AM and post BLEU numbers. if all green we'll promote the new quant artifact.
miko: huge thanks, team. for tracking: created internal issue RED-ML-4812.
eval-bot: Eval summary (preliminary): fp16 zh_Hant BLEU=25.5, int8-fastmerge BLEU=21.3, int8-regenerated BLEU=25.4 — looks recovered. https://ci.redwood/runs/17912
kai: great — when you merge candidate patch, let's add a small unit test asserting bracket token atomization for the unicode range U+3000..U+303F.
rahul: adding test in `tests/tokenizer/test_bracket_ranges.py` now.
miko: deploying smoke after merge. will report back if any residual RTL bracket flips for ar_EG.
eva: also add a short note in the model onboarding checklist about locking tokenizer hash seed during quant table generation.
sarah: note to self: follow-up PR to add per-locale detok regression to the nightly suite. :ok_hand:
